final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes an article comparing C# List<T> and HashSet<T>. Theme: 一个 List 保留位置和每一次出现，一个 HashSet 按比较器只保留成员资格；相等性和顺序是两套互相独立的策略。The reader should quickly feel 先回答「一次出现代表什么」，再决定用哪种容器，以及是否要额外补上顺序或身份层。Summary angle: 同一组产品编号分岔走两条路：一条保留每次经过的卡片，另一条只留一张代表，第三条路是判重加保序。Narrative flow: before-after. In a 2.35:1 frame keep one dominant focal subject and 3 supporting narrative beats; each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration. Information blocks: (1) contrast — a long horizontal conveyor track on the left carries flat numbered product cards side by side, the same card P-100 appears twice and short position tick marks sit under the cards, small Chinese label 「保留重复」; (2) contrast — on the right the same numbered cards funnel into one single square membership slot that keeps only one representative card while the duplicate card is absorbed into the slot shadow, small Chinese label 「合并成员」; (3) step — a branching arrow path leaves the left track, passes through the single slot, and merges into a new lower track that holds only first occurrences, small Chinese label 「首次出现」. Main metaphor: 同一条传送带上的编号卡片在分岔口走两条路：一条保留每次经过，另一条只留一张代表。Primary subject: 一张重复出现的产品编号卡片, 在分岔轨道上被保留或被合并成单一成员。Composition: 左右对照 — left track stacked with cards, right single slot gathering members, lower arrow path joining a new track; horizontal storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover. Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: painterly digital illustration, rich brushwork, volumetric lighting, strong focal contrast, textured color masses. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: warm amber, teal, deep ink. Visible text policy: allow only 3 short Chinese labels 「保留重复」「合并成员」「首次出现」 and tiny 2-4 character card codes such as P-100 and P-200; no poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: webpage screenshot, real code editor, dashboard, floating chips, neon cyberpunk, english slogans, poster title text, watermark. Refine for the final cover: keep exactly this composition and metaphor; render the three Chinese labels 保留重复 / 合并成员 / 首次出现 crisp and correctly formed; inside the single square membership slot show one clearly dominant representative card P-100 with only a faint absorbed duplicate outline behind it; keep the short position tick marks visible under the left track cards and the arrow path flowing into the lower first-occurrence track; remove the ambiguous wooden object in the lower-left foreground and all decorative clutter so the frame contains only the three conveyor tracks, the single slot, and the branching numbered card; strengthen warm amber key light against a deep ink background with teal shadow masses; keep the frame clean at the edges for a wide blog cover.
